common_name: Late Cretaceous uncoiled straight-shaft heteromorph ammonite

phenomenon_scale.statement: Critical Turing pigment wavelength λ_c = 94.16 µm (9.416e-05 m) on the Baculites compressus mantle at the cellular detail tier.

paleobiology.horizon: Pierre Shale, Baculites compressus Zone, upper Campanian

predecessor.what_changes: Involute rounded aperture lengthens the mantle generating curve, so the same cell-frame chemistry is read out at χ = 3/2.

this_node.what_changes: Orthoconic compressed shaft. χ = 1 normalizes the critical wavelength to the assigned 94.16 µm detail scale. Diffusion ratio r = 9.2 sits just above the Schnakenberg threshold r_c ≈ 8.568, so the fastest mode stays within a few micrometres of k_c.

successor.age_note: Turonian, geologically older. Successor only in suture-geometry series order.
successor.what_changes: Whorl recontact shortens the free margin (χ = 6215/9416) and breaks the pigment record into shorter ocellus spacing.

equations.steady_state: u0 = a + b, v0 = b / (a + b)²
equations.turing_wavenumber: k_c² = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)

parameters.note: D_u is solved so that the k_c formula returns λ_c = 94.16 µm at r = 9.2 and χ = 1. D_v = r D_u.

boundary_conditions.dispersion_probe: 1D periodic interval containing an integer number of wavelengths of the probed mode
boundary_conditions.flank_render: band-limited mode packet on a capsule mask of the polished shaft; pigment opacity grows with the linear saturation envelope 1 - exp(-σ t)
boundary_conditions.ablation: D_v set equal to D_u (ratio 1), which lies below r_c so σ(k_c) < 0

empirical_claims.claim: A two-species reaction that is stable without diffusion can be unstable to a finite band of wavenumbers when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator.
The trimolecular reaction a ⇌ u, 2u + v ⇌ 3u, b ⇌ v has a unique positive steady state that can undergo a diffusion-driven instability.
Pigment patterns on mollusc shells are the historical record of a reaction-diffusion system operating on the growing mantle edge.
Baculites compressus begins with a coiled stage before the shell becomes an orthoconic shaft.
Baculites compressus from the Pierre Shale of South Dakota is upper Campanian. This loop's numeric age for that zone is 73.5 Ma.

does_not_claim: The 94.16 µm figure was not measured with a caliper on the Kevmin photograph. It is the critical wavelength imposed by the k_c formula at this tier.
χ for Placenticeras and Nipponites is not a published pigment measurement.
The Wikimedia caption age of 100 Ma is not used.
The flank image is a band-limited projection for specimen comparison, not a histological micrograph at 94 µm per pixel.
